dedupe_keys.name: project haystack semantic data models for building and iot data

description: Project Haystack is an open-source initiative that standardises semantic data models and web services for data from smart devices in homes, buildings, factories and cities, with applications in automation, control, energy, HVAC, lighting and other environmental systems. It addresses the poor semantic modelling of most operational data, which otherwise has to be mapped by hand before analysis, through naming conventions and taxonomies that owners can specify for their building automation systems and that integrators and manufacturers can build into products. Coverage: any building or connected facility. Access: documentation, examples, downloads and a forum on the website. Licence: the community and its intellectual property are managed under the Academic Free License 3.0, open for any commercial use; free. Caveats: tagging is flexible, so two Haystack models of similar buildings can differ, and the page gives no adoption figures. Simulation uses are consistent point and equipment tagging so that building data feed analytics, fault detection and digital twin models without manual mapping. Related records: Brick Schema, RealEstateCore and the Google Digital Buildings ontology.
